comparison.objective: Slide an ungrippable wide casting onto 3-2-1 locating pins; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-guided sliding and multi-pin seating differs from recessed hex-key use, bimanual counterholding, collar tuning, and impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Casting fully seated on its locators versus two non-bottoming stops within dynamic and retention limits. Record has no body/spec rubric.
comparison.reason: Generic alignment/contact control is shared, but the mechanisms and successful outcomes are materially different.
